mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_vendor (vendor_type_cd, biz_no, company_nm, ceo_nm, biz_kind, biz_item, address, zipcode, contact_nm, contact_phone, contact_email, bank_cd, bank_account, bank_holder, tax_type_cd, memo, use_yn) VALUES (#{vendorTypeCd}, #{bizNo}, #{companyNm}, #{ceoNm}, #{bizKind}, #{bizItem}, #{address}, #{zipcode}, #{contactNm}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{bankCd}, #{bankAccount}, #{bankHolder}, COALESCE(#{taxTypeCd}, 'GENERAL'), #{memo}, 'Y')

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM gw_vendor WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND (LOWER(company_nm) LIKE LOWER('%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR biz_no LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND (vendor_type_cd = #{type} OR vendor_type_cd = 'BOTH')
